content.json:
## usnewsmap API
Requests from `AppRequests` (health probes excluded), metrics from `AppMetrics`, availability tests from `AppAvailabilityResults` and the API's console lines from `ContainerAppConsoleLogs` (08 §8.1.2). Times are UTC. No search text is recorded anywhere this reads.

content.query:
let requests = AppRequests
    | where AppRoleName == "usnm-api";
let totals = requests
    | summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount), Server5xx = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500);
let p95 = requests
    | where Name !endswith "(site)" and Name !endswith "(no route)"
    | summarize P95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95);
totals
| extend P95 = toscalar(p95)
| mv-expand Tile = pack_array(
    pack("Name", "Requests", "Value", todouble(Requests)),
    pack("Name", "5xx error rate, %", "Value", iff(Requests == 0, 0.0, round(100.0 * Server5xx / Requests, 2))),
    pack("Name", "p95 latency of API routes, ms", "Value", round(P95, 0)))
| project Name = tostring(Tile.Name), Value = todouble(Tile.Value)
content.title: Requests in the time range

content.query:
AppRequests
| where AppRoleName == "usnm-api"
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Route = Name
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Requests by route

content.query:
AppRequests
| where AppRoleName == "usnm-api"
| summarize Requests = sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Status = strcat(substring(ResultCode, 0, 1), "xx")
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Requests by status class

content.query:
AppRequests
| where AppRoleName == "usnm-api"
| summarize
    Requests = sum(ItemCount),
    Client4xx = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) between (400 .. 499)),
    Server5xx = sumif(ItemCount, toint(ResultCode) >= 500),
    P50ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50), 1),
    P95ms = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 1),
    MaxMs = round(max(DurationMs), 1)
    by Route = Name
| order by Requests desc
| take 50
content.title: Latency by route, ms

content.query:
AppRequests
| where AppRoleName == "usnm-api"
| where Name !endswith "(site)" and Name !endswith "(no route)"
| summarize P95ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Route = Name
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: p95 latency by API route, ms

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where AppRoleName == "usnm-api" and Name == "api.backend_duration_seconds"
| extend Series = strcat(tostring(Properties.endpoint), ", ", tostring(Properties.outcome))
| summarize MeanSecs = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount), MaxSecs = max(Max) by Series
content.title: Search backend time by endpoint and outcome, s (mean and max)
content.noDataMessage: No search reached the backend in the time range.

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where AppRoleName == "usnm-api" and Name == "api.backend_duration_seconds"
| summarize MaxSecs = max(Max) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Series = strcat(tostring(Properties.endpoint), ", ", tostring(Properties.outcome))
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Search backend time, slowest per interval, s
content.noDataMessage: No search reached the backend in the time range.

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where AppRoleName == "usnm-api" and Name == "api.cache_lookups"
| extend Layer = tostring(Properties.layer), Hit = tostring(Properties.result) == "hit"
| summarize Lookups = sum(Sum), Hits = sumif(Sum, Hit) by Layer
| extend HitRatePercent = round(100.0 * Hits / Lookups, 1), Misses = Lookups - Hits
| project Layer, Lookups, Hits, Misses, HitRatePercent
content.title: Response cache lookups by layer
content.noDataMessage: No cache lookups in the time range.

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where AppRoleName == "usnm-api" and Name == "api.cache_lookups"
| extend Layer = tostring(Properties.layer), Hit = tostring(Properties.result) == "hit"
| summarize HitRatePercent = round(100.0 * sumif(Sum, Hit) / sum(Sum), 1) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Layer
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Response cache hit rate by layer, %
content.noDataMessage: No cache lookups in the time range.

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where AppRoleName == "usnm-api" and Name == "api.rejected_queries"
| summarize Rejected = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Reason = tostring(Properties.reason)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Rejected queries by reason
content.noDataMessage: No rejected queries in the time range.

content.query:
AppAvailabilityResults
| summarize SuccessPercent = round(100.0 * countif(Success == true) / count(), 1)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Location = strcat(Name, ", ", Location)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Availability tests: success % by test and location
content.noDataMessage: No availability results in the time range.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| where ContainerName == "api"
| where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
| where Log has "warm-up finished"
| extend j = parse_json(Log)
| where tostring(j.fields.message) == "warm-up finished"
| project TimeGenerated, Trigger = tostring(j.fields["trigger"]), Version = tostring(j.fields["version"]),
    Queries = tolong(j.fields["queries"]), Ok = tolong(j.fields["ok"]), Failed = tolong(j.fields["failed"]),
    TimedOut = tolong(j.fields["timed_out"]), Skipped = tolong(j.fields["skipped"]), Ms = tolong(j.fields["ms"]),
    Replica = ContainerGroupName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Cache warm-up runs
content.noDataMessage: No warm-up runs in the time range.

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs
| where ContainerName == "api"
| where Log !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Log !has "MSI_SECRET"
| where Log has_any ("publishing new index version", "reload failed", "initial load failed", "loaded memory index")
| extend j = parse_json(Log)
| extend Message = tostring(j.fields.message)
| where Message in ("publishing new index version", "reload failed; keeping current version", "initial load failed; retrying")
| summarize Count = count(), First = min(TimeGenerated), Last = max(TimeGenerated)
    by Event = Message, Version = tostring(j.fields.version), Error = substring(tostring(j.fields.error), 0, 300), Replica = ContainerGroupName
| order by Last desc
| take 100
content.title: Reference data loads: new versions published, failed reloads, failed initial loads
content.noDataMessage: No reference data loads in the time range.
